title: Pinned Spellbook provenance and unexecuted query blueprints for daily macro metrics
objective: Produce reproducible, SHA-pinned source evidence and unexecuted DuneSQL blueprints for the offline macro metric whitelist. This research must not execute Dune queries or use credentials.
forbidden_actions: Do not read, use, print or store API keys, cookies, browser state, credentials or environment values.
Do not execute Dune API, CLI, dashboard or paid queries; do not create, edit or save a Dune query/dashboard.
Do not modify repository SQL, source, migrations, tests, task specifications, ledger, provider configuration or schedules.
Do not infer SQL body, query freshness or coverage from dashboard screenshots/titles, query IDs, or current Spellbook main without a pinned commit SHA.
Do not claim all-chain Robinhood coverage, Four.meme launch coverage, stablecoin supply, bridge flow, global TVL, market cap/FDV, or survival/drawdown cohorts.
deliverables: A source-lock matrix with full Spellbook commit SHA, immutable GitHub URL, table/model path, exact field names, chain values, timestamp semantics, dedup grain and coverage limits for every permitted metric.
Unexecuted DuneSQL blueprints using explicit report-day/profile-window parameters for the permitted global, Solana, BSC and Uniswap-scoped Robinhood metrics and UTC hourly profiles.
A mapping from each blueprint to macro metric name, unit, section, registry_version, coverage_status, query_ref/query_version fields, expected completeness and warnings.
An explicit execution boundary: no blueprint may be called VERIFIED-as-executed until a separately Owner-authorized run stores query ID, SQL hash, execution ID, source_as_of and result checksum.
